meta.name: #I'm Looking for a Zombie
meta.description: It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it's amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they've never felt more alive.

videos.title: I'm Looking for My Dad
videos.overview: 13 years after the "Red Day," Aki leaves the village with Natsuki and Haru to search for her father.

videos.title: I'm Looking for My Friends
videos.overview: Aki and her group meet Mikazuki, who is searching for her friends.

videos.title: I’m Looking for a Photo Shop
videos.overview: Aki and her group go out to find a photo shop to develop the film left in her dad's camera.

videos.title: I'm Looking for a Hospital
videos.overview: Aki and Yu set out to find a hospital to treat Natsuki's wound.

videos.title: I'm Looking for a Mechanic
videos.overview: Yu and Haru meet Toka while looking for parts to fix the car.

videos.title: I'm Visiting a Zoo
videos.overview: On their way to Tokyo Tower, the group takes a detour to explore the base built by Takamo and her people.

videos.title: I'm Helping the Zoo
videos.overview: As Aki and her friends fight zombies to save the zoo, Sakura and Saigo become friends.
